before.value:
帧是否是模块级、每个进程按参数只执行一次的缓存加载器的函数体。

    这类加载器（随包分发的 schema、规则表）与函数内的延迟 import 同类，首次调用落在哪个用例
    取决于 xdist 的调度，不放行会让违规随运行顺序出现或消失。只认无上限的 ``functools.cache``
    （``lru_cache(maxsize=None)``）和无参函数：有容量上限、按参数缓存的函数会淘汰后重读，
    每次重读都是一次真实的阻塞。

after.value:
Whether the frame is a module-level cache-loader body executed once per argument set per process.

    These loaders (bundled schemas/rule tables) resemble delayed imports; xdist scheduling determines
    the first caller. Without exemption, violations appear or disappear with execution order. Accept only
    unbounded ``functools.cache`` (``lru_cache(maxsize=None)``) and zero-argument functions:
    bounded argument-keyed caches can evict and reread, and every reread is real blocking.

只在铸造临时库的进程里回收它。

    atexit 登记表随 fork 复制到子进程。mutmut 按 mutant fork 出的 pytest 会话若走了

    删掉所有并行子进程共用的库，之后每个子进程的会话级 DB fixture 都报错。

after.value:

    instead of ``os._exit`` would run parent callbacks; without PID guards they could delete DBs shared
    by parallel children, causing all session-level DB fixtures to fail.

before.value:
fork 出的子进程丢弃模块级 engine 池里从父进程继承的连接。

    aiosqlite 每个连接由一条专属工作线程驱动，fork 只复制调用线程，子进程里池中
    连接的工作线程不存在，经它发出的任何查询都永远等不到结果。``close=False``
    只丢引用不关连接，父进程那份连接不受影响。mutmut 按 mutant fork 跑测试，
    子进程首个走 ``lib.db.engine`` 的用例会就此挂到超时。父进程从未 import 过
    该模块时池中无连接可丢，也不在子进程里触发 engine 创建。

after.value:
Fork children discard module-engine pooled connections inherited from parents.

    Each aiosqlite connection has a worker thread, but fork copies only the calling thread; inherited pooled
    connections lack their workers and queries wait forever. ``close=False`` discards references without
    closing parent connections. Mutmut forks per-mutant tests, whose first ``lib.db.engine`` access
    would otherwise hang until timeout. If parents never imported it, there are no connections to discard,
    and do not create engines in children.

before.value:
让 `first` 停在剧本锁临界区内，确认 `second` 被锁挡在外面后再放行，返回两者的响应。

    交错点由钩子对齐而非靠线程调度碰运气：钩子挂在剧本写盘 seam 上（`locked_script`
    退出前的最后一步），此时先到的一方已经做完自己的文件副作用、字段写回尚未落盘——正是
    「一方写完文件、对方抢在字段写回前动手」这一悬空引用场景的临界点。后到的一方在此期间
    必须仍被剧本锁挡住：它若能完成，就说明两段操作没有真正互斥。

    两个请求错开发出还有一层必要性：TestClient 每个请求起独立线程与事件循环，而 FastAPI 对
    `include_router` 的路由展开是首次匹配时惰性构建、且不加锁；同时发出的两个首请求会撞上
    半构建的路由表，随机得到路由级 404。此处第二个请求在第一个请求完成路由之后才发出。

    「后到的一方没能完成」这一断言以固定等待窗口否证，是单向的：互斥若被破坏，慢机上后到
    的一方也可能因窗口内尚未跑完而漏报；但绝不会反过来把守规矩的实现判成失败，故不引入
    时序敏感性。不带锁的整条 set/clear 是毫秒级，窗口取值远宽于此。

after.value:
Pause `first` inside script locks, confirm `second` waits outside, then release and return responses.

    Hooks align interleavings rather than lucky scheduling: script-write seams run at the last step before `locked_script`
    exits, after first file side effects but before field persistence, precisely the
    dangling-reference window where others could edit between file writes and field writes. Later requests must
    remain locked out; completion would prove operations are not truly exclusive.

    Staggering requests also matters: TestClient uses independent threads/loops, while FastAPI
    `include_router` lazily expands routes on first matches without locks; simultaneous first requests hit
    half-built tables and randomly return route 404. Send second requests only after first routing completes.

    Asserting later requests cannot finish uses fixed observation windows, a one-way falsification: broken exclusion on slow
    machines may miss detection because work has not finished, but never falsely rejects compliant implementations, avoiding
    timing sensitivity. Entire unlocked set/clear operations take milliseconds, much shorter than windows.

before.value:
模拟「回滚重新过锁前，另一个并发请求已抢先完整地执行完自己的一次操作」。

    回滚判定的是「操作代次」而非文件内容（见 end_frame.py 模块 docstring 的退化值说明），
    所以这里不能只改文件字节，还要推进该分镜的代次，否则复现不出代次判定要拦截的场景。
    `content=None` 表示并发的那一次是清除（文件被删）；否则表示并发的那一次是设置。

    补偿回滚会再发起一次 `locked_script`，其剧本读取即回滚临界区的起点——在其第 n 次被
    调用时执行注入的「并发接管」，相当于恰好在回滚拿到锁之前完成。挂钩点取剧本读盘 seam：
    锁外的 `load_script` 与锁内的读-改-写都经它读盘，计数才覆盖两类临界区起点。

after.value:
Simulate concurrent operations finishing fully before rollback reacquires locks.

    Rollback checks operation generations, not bytes (see end_frame.py degenerate-value docs),
    so change generation counters as well as bytes to reproduce guarded takeovers.
    `content=None` means concurrent clearing/deletion; other values mean setting.

    Compensation calls `locked_script` again; its read begins rollback critical sections. Inject takeover at read n,
    equivalent to completion immediately before rollback acquires locks. Script-read seams
    serve both unlocked `load_script` and locked read-modify-write, counting both critical-section starts.

    intervals with nonyielding waits and global ``time.monotonic``. Repeated processing responses would keep polling at other test yield points,

Construct an N-chapter .epub by writing an OCF/OPF-compliant zip directly.

    - ``toc``: table-of-contents source, ``"ncx+nav"`` (default), ``"ncx"``, ``"nav"``, or ``None`` (no TOC).
    - ``toc_entries``: override TOC entries as ``(标题, 相对 OPF 目录的 href)``; default one per chapter.

    - ``opf_dir``: OPF directory, shared by chapters, NCX, and nav.

before.value:
让提交请求停在一道只由取消解除的闸口上，run 在测试说停之前一定还在进行。

    「仍在进行」若靠 ``status: processing`` 的轮询维持，就成了一场竞速：假表下的一轮轮询几乎
    不耗真实时间，后台任务能在两次断言之间跑满 ``poll_timeout`` 撞进终态、把名额让出去。闸口
    把这段生命周期交给测试，机器负载再高结论也不变。

    每个提交请求到达闸口时往返回的队列里放一项。取消前先经 ``client.portal.call(queue.get)``
    等它：``create`` 返回时后台任务可能还在提交之前的记账插入里，取消落在那里会让 SQLAlchemy
    作废连接，内存库随唯一的连接一起丢掉表，下一笔 run 插账即失败、自行结束，取消它得到 404。

after.value:
Block submissions behind cancellation-only gates, ensuring runs remain ongoing until tests stop them.

    Maintaining ongoing states through ``status: processing`` polling creates races: fake-clock polls take almost
    no real time, so background tasks may exhaust ``poll_timeout`` between assertions, become terminal and release slots. Gates
    place lifecycle control in tests, keeping conclusions independent of machine load.

    Each submission reaching gates adds an item to returned queues. Before cancellation, await it through ``client.portal.call(queue.get)``:
    after ``create`` returns, background tasks may still insert presubmission billing records; cancellation there makes SQLAlchemy
    invalidate connections, losing in-memory tables with the sole connection. Next runs fail billing insertion and end themselves, yielding cancellation 404.
